phase_2_primary_earliest_failure_cause.rule: One primary earliest cause per non-accepted opportunity. Downstream symptoms are not counted as separate primary causes.

independent_secondary_defects.detail: A distractor rationale inverted CLM-R2-SURG-NONOP, reporting a 53% crossover-to-surgery rate as a 53% appendectomy-avoidance rate. Not downstream of the primary cause; recorded separately so it is not lost to the one-primary rule. Same family as R4's McBurney unit error: nothing checks a quoted figure's direction against the claim's meaning.

excluded_from_count.G2-PHELO-03: The verifier names the mode only to rule it out: the anchor exists ('a completed economic evaluation') but is purely refuting. Classified F_COMPETITOR_TOO_EASILY_EXCLUDED_BY_STEM.

phase_3_competitor_without_stem_anchor.accounting_observation: The execution report's repeated-defect block names 4 items in 3 profiles. Its own source verifications carry explicit COMPETITOR_WITHOUT_STEM_ANCHOR findings for 6 items in 4 profiles. G2-SURG-03 and G2-PSY-04 are absent from the aggregate because each was headlined under a different defect (numeric inversion; option nesting). Reported, not changed.

mechanism.1_realized_stem_features: A seed's frozen correctness condition names the stem feature under which the competitor would be right. The wave plan authors the stem feature map before retrieval runs, and the way to keep the key unique is to report those features absent.
mechanism.2_retrieval_query_dimensions: The index filters on discipline_profile_id x item_archetype x option_set_archetype only. learner_decision_id is carried in the query record and is never used as a filter (scripts/qbank/profile_contrast_retrieval.py, retrieve_profile_aware_contrasts).
mechanism.3_retrieved_seed_metadata: Anchoring is measurable only through condition_predicates. shared_features_with_key is free prose that is never joined to the canonical stem-feature vocabulary.
mechanism.4_why_ranked_and_admitted: ADM_3 excludes a competitor whose correctness conditions are FULLY satisfied, because that is a second key. There is no corresponding floor: a competitor with 0 of N satisfied conditions is admitted unpenalised. The pipeline has a ceiling on anchoring and no floor.
mechanism.5_candidate_visible_evidence: Because the competitor's own condition is negated, the only remaining plausibility is generic topical similarity, which is what the distractor rationales then assert.
mechanism.6_independent_review_reasoning: Verifiers quote the stem's own negation clauses back and, in three items, quote the item's own distractor rationale conceding the exclusion.

measurements.ranking_signal_degeneracy: Constant in 20 of 26 sets, so ranking collapses to reviewed seed strength and then alphabetical seed_id.
measurements.SA_2_note: SA_2 encodes exactly this criterion but its verdicts are authored rather than computed, and it refused nothing in 111 ranked candidates.

seeds_with_zero_condition_predicates.note: The pack's empty_predicate_convention: a seed whose curated condition text says it is never correct carries no predicate. Such a seed is structurally unanchorable to any stem.

answers.retrieved_because_profile_or_archetype_t: PARTLY. True for the four D_WRONG_DECISION_GRANULARITY opportunities, where the index reused a pool curated for another decision. NOT true for the flagship anchorless cases: G2-MED-01 and G2-PED-01 used seeds purpose-built for that exact target and still produced a fully negated set.
answers.admitted_because_contextual_filtering_re: PARTLY. SA-1..SA-3 verdicts are authored, and the one criterion that names this defect (SA_2) fired zero times.
answers.something_else: The decisive finding. Anchoring is defined only negatively in the architecture. The single machine-readable link between a competitor and a stem is its correctness condition, and the only automated test over that link is an anti-second-key ceiling. Nothing requires a competitor to retain positive pull, so a stem that keeps the key unique by negating every competitor is admissible by construction.

phase_4_accepted_controls.empirical_distinction: Not seed strength, not the number of satisfied correctness conditions (104 of 111 ranked candidates scored zero in both groups alike), and not the present-to-absent feature ratio (accepted G2-SURG-02 runs 2 present to 5 absent, rejected G2-PSY-04 runs 4 to 3). The distinction is HOW the stem defeats the competitor. In the accepted controls 7 of 12 selected competitors are defeated by a positively stated datum the candidate must convert into an exclusion - a threshold ('about four hours' against an undisclosed 120-minute rule), a comparison (equal incidence and equal deaths against longer survival from diagnosis), a availability or preference fact - and only 2 of 12 absent stem features are written as an explicit verbal denial. In the anchorless rejections 13 of 18 selected competitors are defeated by the stem stating the competitor's own precondition absent in words ('no back pain and no pulse deficit', 'There was no choking episode', 'no imaging was requested'), and 17 of 30 absent features are explicit verbal denials.
phase_4_accepted_controls.discriminating_property: An accepted distractor remains a LIVE BUT INFERIOR course of action for this patient, defeated by a comparative or threshold judgement. A rejected anchorless distractor is a CATEGORICALLY IMPOSSIBLE course of action, defeated by a stated absence that requires no clinical knowledge to apply.
phase_4_accepted_controls.corroborating_case: G2-MED-04 was accepted with 2 of its 3 competitors carrying zero condition predicates. Zero-predicate seeds are not fatal in themselves. Its never-correct options ('angiography in three to five days', 'transfer only if the electrocardiogram fails to show resolution') are never OPTIMAL yet remain selectable reperfusion routes invited by the geography written into the stem. G2-OBGYN-03's zero-predicate options ('apply firm deep massage', 'use a nipple shield') are never APPROPRIATE. The library does not distinguish the two.
phase_4_accepted_controls.no_rule_proposed: Per the task, the empirical distinction is recorded and no new rule is designed here.

phase_6_rejected_root_cause.note: INDEPENDENT_QUALITY_ONLY is zero: every rejection traces to a locus inside the pipeline, not to reviewer taste. Three blind verifiers reached the keyed answer on 17 of 17 items before seeing any key, so no rejection is a keying error.

accounting_defect.finding: Two of the nineteen alarmed decisions are already covered. LD-GS76-02 carries accepted item G2-SURG-02 and LD-PH07-01 carries accepted item G2-PHELO-01, yet both appear in UNCOVERED_HIGH_PRIORITY_DECISION_AT_CORE.
accounting_defect.mechanism: build_coverage_row scopes 'relevant' opportunities to (allocation_address x mcc_objective) but subtracts them from declared_learner_decisions, which is the whole study unit's decision list. A study unit spanning k objective rows therefore reports each decision as uncovered in the k-1 rows where it was not attempted. evaluate_standing_alarms then unions those lists with no subtraction, while its sibling alarm CORE_OBJECTIVE_WITH_NO_ACCEPTED_ITEM does subtract objectives accepted elsewhere ('truly_absent'). The two alarms are asymmetric.
accounting_defect.action: Reported only. No artifact, alarm or verdict changed.

actionable_generation_gaps.basis: 12 attempted and rejected on realization defects that a repaired pipeline could clear, plus 2 never attempted (LD-C21-03, LD-PS12-04).

reasoning: The rule's INTENT is correct and is not in tension with safe-yield policy. It demands that every CORE learner decision reach a terminal state, and it accepts NO_SAFE_ITEM as terminal, so it never demands a quota and never penalises fail-closed refusal. It is not TOO_STRICT_FOR_SAFE_YIELD.

The rule's IMPLEMENTATION joins a study-unit-scoped decision list to an objective-scoped outcome set, so for a study unit mapped to k MCC objectives it demands k terminal outcomes per decision. SU-GS-76 would need 12 terminal outcomes for 4 decisions to clear its three rows. That is unsatisfiable by construction, not strict.

The mismatch inflates the reason set but does not flip the verdict. Recomputed with study-unit scoping, 14 CORE decisions remain genuinely neither accepted nor fail-closed, so evaluate_gate('G2') = FAIL is the right verdict reached through an over-counting join.
phase_8_internal_gate_assessment.status_justification: Accepted-item quality is established and not in doubt: factual, numeric, unsupported-claim, ambiguous-best-answer, critical-fact-safety and material-redundancy counts are all zero in accepted items, evidence entailment passes over them, and three blind verifiers reached the keyed answer on 17 of 17. Scale is blocked on two independent grounds: 0 of 6 profiles validated, and 14 CORE decisions unresolved. 'MIXED' understates the second; 'FAIL' understates the first.
phase_8_internal_gate_assessment.not_changed: The encoded gate was read, not modified.

evidence: It is the largest single primary cause among rejections (4 of 13) and it is the mode that recurs across waves: G1 named it, G2 reproduced it in 4 profiles, and no automated gate covers it.

It is architectural, not incidental: 104 of 111 ranked candidates scored zero satisfied correctness conditions, the primary ranking signal was constant in 20 of 26 retrieval sets, and SA_2, the one criterion that encodes the defect, refused nothing.
It is not a supply problem. G2-MED-01 and G2-PED-01, the two clearest cases, used seeds curated for exactly that target. Purpose-built seeds produced fully negated sets.
The accepted controls separate cleanly on it and on nothing else, which makes it the property that distinguishes an item that passes from one that does not.

secondary_bottlenecks.evidence: 10 of 12 fail-closed outcomes are supply or nominal-parity shortfalls. Real, but demoted: G2 already spent its one targeted enrichment pass (23 authored, 19 approved) and no terminal state moved to ACCEPTED. In R4 the same intervention removed every fail-closed outcome without raising the score. Adding seeds converts NO_SAFE_ITEM into REJECTED; it has not yet converted either into ACCEPTED.
The index does not key on the learner decision, which produced 22 of 28 semantic refusals and 4 fail-closed outcomes. Bounded and well characterised.

3 primary causes under G plus 5 items carrying KEY_DISTRACTOR_REGISTER_ASYMMETRY. Created by the provenance rule itself: distractor text is locked to the curated concept string while the key is written fresh, so the key differs in form, hedging and length. ADM_5 measures numerals only.
3 primary causes under I plus 5 items carrying RATIONALE_CLAIM_OUTSIDE_THE_ITEM_EVIDENCE_SET. Nothing checks that a rationale stays inside the claims the item declared.

not_the_bottleneck.OPPORTUNITY_SELECTION: Opportunities were drawn from the frozen priority model and the redundancy control fired correctly. Only 2 of 19 uncovered CORE decisions were never attempted.
not_the_bottleneck.MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_BOTTLENECKS: Considered and rejected as the headline. Four loci are active, but they are not co-equal: one of them alone explains the accepted-versus-rejected split and recurs across two waves and four profiles.

why_it_follows_from_the_matrix: It targets the primary bottleneck and the only defect class the accepted controls separate on.

It is bounded and computable from artifacts that already exist and are frozen: condition_predicates on each seed, the canonical stem feature vocabulary, and the realized stem feature map. No new acquisition, no new schema, no new judgement.

The measurement it needs is already proven to discriminate: defeat mode per selected competitor, 7 of 12 by positive datum in accepted items against 13 of 18 by explicit verbal denial in the anchorless rejections.
It closes the ceiling-without-floor asymmetry directly: retrieval already refuses a fully satisfied competitor as a second key and would gain the symmetric refusal of a wholly unanchored one.

alternatives_considered_and_why_not.TARGETED_CONTRAST_LIBRARY_EXPANSION: Ruled out by evidence, not preference. Tried twice (R4 seed packs, G2 targeted enrichment) and neither raised accepted yield. The enrichment bound is also spent and no further seed round is authorised.
alternatives_considered_and_why_not.DISCIPLINE_SPECIFIC_RETRIEVAL_RULES: The dominant defect spans MEDICINE, PEDIATRICS, PSYCHIATRY and SURGERY. A per-discipline rule cannot catch a cross-profile architectural gap.
alternatives_considered_and_why_not.OPPORTUNITY_SELECTION_REDESIGN: Would address the granularity refusals, but those end in safe fail-closed states. It does not touch the 13 rejections.
alternatives_considered_and_why_not.HUMAN_CURATED_OPTION_SETS_FOR_LOW_YIELD_: Abandons the automated path before its single largest known defect has been tested once.
alternatives_considered_and_why_not.NO_ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_RUN_LARGER_SAFE_Y: 0 of 6 profiles validated and the same four modes recurred at 30 opportunities that recurred at 11. A larger sample of the same architecture measures the same defect more precisely; it does not move yield.

phase_10_next_intervention.stop_rule_observed: Recommended only. No production code, validator, seed, question, gate or verdict was changed by this task.
